name: EPIC 202602988
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 10.6 solar radii and 1.13 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 202602988 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.588371 (16th-84th percentiles 9.995239-10.837082), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 1,571 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 1.13 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,626 K at its surface.
